job.question: In the Los Angeles City Employees' Retirement System (LACERS) actuarial RFP, how many years of experience must the lead actuary have?
job.expected_facts: At least 15 years of experience with major public employee retirement systems, including at least 3 years with California public pension fund clients similar to LACERS.
job.acceptance: Accept 15 total and three California years. Do not require credential details unrelated to the years asked.

reviews.reason: This is CCCERA’s 2018 master-custodian RFP, not LACERS’ actuarial RFP. Its experience requirements concern custody services and an account administrator, not a lead actuary.
quotes: REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS FOR MASTER CUSTODIAN AND RELATED SERVICES April 2018 Contra Costa County Employees’ Retirement Association

The account administrator (the individual primarily assigned to CCCERA’s account and in charge of the day-to-day contact) proposed for this engagement must have a minimum of five (5) years of experience (three [3] years at the proposing company) in custody.
